slides.title: Meet Gizmo
slides.text: Gizmo the mouse fixes gadgets in a little workshop. Gizmo knows that every device is a team of parts.
slides.alt: Inside the Machine's title screen: Gizmo the mouse. Parts, fixes, bits and gadgets with Gizmo.

focus.cue: Parts, fixes, bits and gadgets with Gizmo

slides.title: Every part has a job
slides.text: Inputs take things in, like the touch sensor and camera. Outputs give things out, like the screen. The processor thinks, storage remembers and the battery powers it all.
slides.alt: Which part takes the photo? Screen, microphone, speaker, battery, touch sensor or camera: every part has its own job.

slides.title: A tap travels
slides.text: Follow one tap from your finger to the screen. Each part does its job, then passes it on.
slides.alt: A Tap Travels: your finger taps, the touch sensor feels it, the processor works it out, the camera app says take a photo.

focus.cue: Your finger taps; the touch sensor feels it
The app says: take a photo

slides.title: Hardware and software
slides.text: Hardware is what you can touch, like the screen. Software is the instructions, like an app. You see an app on the screen, but the app is software.
slides.alt: Sorting cards into Hardware, what you can touch, and Software, the instructions. Five cards are sorted so far.

focus.cue: A card to sort: a drawing app. Can you touch it?
Hardware you can touch, or software: instructions

slides.title: Every task needs both
slides.text: A photo needs the camera (hardware) and the camera app (software). And no part works without power from the battery.
slides.alt: A Tap Travels: your finger taps, the touch sensor feels it, the processor works it out, the camera app says take a photo.

focus.cue: Hardware: the touch sensor, and the camera next

slides.text: Open Inside the Machine at Parts & Jobs and finish all 6 levels. Tap the part that does each job, then sort hardware from software.
